goal: Test whether the host feels closer to the official ONE PIECE visual system through surface ratio, geometry and editorial rhythm rather than palette imitation.
mustPreserve: all plaza content, search/filter behavior, deck/event branches, navigation targets and Pokémon media

mustChange.surface: warm-white map-paper canvas dominates; dark color is limited to masthead/navigation and selected editorial moments
mustChange.geometry: low-radius or square content cards and controls; remove dominant pill language
mustChange.colorRoles: navy/black structure, warm-white content, yellow as sparse active accent, red as sparse action/section marker
mustChange.composition: clear masthead, compact taxonomy, breathing space, rectangular content islands and visible first content item
mustChange.type: strong short headings with restrained readable CJK controls/body

mustNotDo: add a full hero above browsing
use generic black-red-yellow presence as acceptance evidence
acceptance: same-viewport source/host comparison shows source-relative surface ratio and rectangular geometry
masked comparison remains recognizable without relying on logo or character art
390x844 and 1280x720 show search, taxonomy and first content without overflow
all existing plaza interactions and keyboard behavior remain unchanged
